title: MinMax Finance (IoTeX) — abandoned Saddle-fork StableSwap pools: $98.5k live, ~$0.04 extractable
closed_reasons: P1/P5/P9 at StableSwap equilibrium: best spot edge (+0.62%/+0.51%/+0.55%) is below the 0.66% round-trip market fee (Mimo 0.3%+0.3% + pool 0.06%); simulation negative at all sizes
Ethereum-bridged io* tokens are impaired by the 2026-02-21 ioTube hack and already trade at $0.54 (not $1); P1 holds four equally-impaired tokens at par = fair pricing
XIM has no liquid exit: three metapools independently imply XIM ~= $0.036; only exit is the MAX/XIM Mimo pair worth $0.72 total in WIOTX terms; 0 XIM transfers in last 40k blocks
Paused metapools (P4/P8/P10 + 5 more): swap/addLiquidity revert; only proportional removeLiquidity (LP-holder-only, H-O)
Admin fees $1,818: withdrawAdminFees() is onlyOwner (EOA 0x226f272a..., no outgoing tx for ~2 years)
No permissionless value-paying function in the Saddle v1 ABI; clones are initialised (re-init reverts)

poc.note: 5/5 verification checks passed on CI (state dump of 19 pools + 10 market pairs; closed-cycle extraction optimiser using the live pools' calculateSwap; Saddle-v1 math equivalence <25 wei; live TokenSwap liveness evidence; LP/admin accounting). IoTeX cannot be forked with anvil/foundry (node returns native fields foundry cannot unmarshal; state pruned >3000 blocks; eth_call state overrides unsupported) - no Foundry fork test exists; see poc/README.md.

Pool set (19 live): 8 base pools + 11 metapools enumerated from archived frontend bundles (2022/2023), DefiLlama adapter f99db7b813, triage set, and clone-pattern probing of every IOTEX address in the bundles
owner() of base pools = EOA 0x226f272a2635523b9d50a8d2b481ced204b4d9c2, dormant ~2 years, holds 581 XIM; early pools owned by 0x025eda... / 0x3f8e52...
Market-priced live value ~= $98.5k vs triage $111,352 (DefiLlama maps ioUSDT/ioDAI to Ethereum underlyings at $1.00; real market $0.538/$0.54)
io-token market anchors (Mimo V2 vs WIOTX, all balanced): ioUSDC $0.540, ioBUSD $0.539, ioUSDT $0.538; BSC/Polygon stables ~$1 (BUSD-bsc $0.999, USDT_b $0.995, DAI-matic $0.995, USDT-matic $0.996)

Best fresh-attacker cycles: A8D ioUSDT->ioUSDC +6.36 WIOTX ($0.024); P7 USDT-matic->USDT_b +2.29 WIOTX ($0.009); P2 ioUSDC->ioBUSD +1.73 WIOTX ($0.007); P6 USDT_b->BUSD-bsc +1.29 WIOTX ($0.005); P11 +0.0013 WIOTX; all P1/P3/P5/P9 pairs negative
Admin fees accrued in pools: $1,818 total (P1 $929, P5 $489, P9 $301, rest ~$100) - owner-only

Live arbitrage bot 0x782e8Aa84ACc4006fF7b0cF45214B200234965D0 runs 5-hop cycles through P1/P5 (e.g. tx 0x4954f267... at block 53,342,593 netting +1.91 WIOTX), keeping the big pools within ~0.2% of equilibrium
Latent: if ioTube compensation re-rates io-tokens to ~$1, P1 becomes a ~$16k extraction target; if a XIM market appears at $0.61, metapools yield ~$140-600
caveats: Pool implementation 0x0e62d07a is unverified source; Saddle-v1 equivalence established behaviourally (calculateSwap/swapStorage/getVirtualPrice match exactly), not by source review
Pause semantics (removeLiquidity unblocked) taken from Saddle v1 source, not fork-verified (forking IoTeX is impossible with public RPCs)
IoTeX public RPC prunes historical state (<=3000 blocks) - all figures are point-in-time at the stated block

Pool set completeness: no factory/registry discoverable (explorer Cloudflare-gated, RPC history pruned); a pool created after 2023 and never in a frontend could be missed, though it would be a micro-metapool by pattern
Micro-arbitrage totals are the sum of best single cycles per pool; combining cycles can only reduce the total
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract only ~$0.04 live from MinMax Finance: the $98.5k of abandoned StableSwap liquidity is at equilibrium with IoTeX's thin markets (io-tokens already priced at $0.54 after the ioTube hack, XIM has no exit), leaving only micro-imbalances in two early pools and the XIM metapools; $1,818 admin fees are owner-only and ~$97k is LP-holder-redeemable.
